events.text: Posters announce county qualifiers for the great tournament.

effects.log: Your name on the list. Your stomach in knots.
You know every one of their habits by the end of the week.

events.text: Your first qualifier bout: a farmer's son with fists like hams.

ok.log: You win cleanly. The crowd cheers his courage and your skill.

fail.log: He wins. You shake his hand.

effects.log: You lose narrowly but learn much.

events.text: A qualifier judge hints that a small gift would help your chances.

effects.log: The other judges hear. The corrupt one is replaced.
You fight fair. It feels better.

events.text: Before your bout, someone offers you a cup of tea. It smells faintly of almonds.

effects.log: You find out later it was drugged.

ok.log: A rival's servant. The rival is disqualified.

fail.log: He slips away in the crowd.

events.text: A thin girl from a poor village is winning every bout. The crowd loves her.

effects.log: She wins her group. She waves at you.
She reaches the final eight.

events.text: Fans of two fighters start a brawl in the stands.

ok.log: Order restored. The organisers thank you.

fail.log: A flying stool finds your head.

choices.text: Protect the children in the stands

effects.log: Nobody small gets hurt.

events.text: A scout from a famous sect watches the qualifiers, taking notes.

effects.log: The scout writes your name down.
The scout notices that too.

events.text: You are injured mid-tournament. One more bout would make it worse.

effects.log: Wise. You heal fully.
You win, limping. It takes months to heal.

events.text: You sneak into the qualifiers under the stands to watch.

effects.log: You practise them all winter.
A fighter signs your sleeve. You never wash it.

events.text: An ancient stone arena, grass growing through the fighting ring.

effects.log: Ghosts of old crowds cheer you on.

choices.text: Read the names on the champions' stone

effects.log: One of them is your surname.

events.text: A man in the stands takes wagers on the bouts.

effects.log: Silver lost on others' fights is silver lost.
Wagering is banned at the tournament. He is thrown out.

events.text: The qualifier results are posted outside the town hall.

effects.log: Win or lose, you have trained harder this month than all year.
Grace in the jianghu is remembered.
